test_cases.test_case: Direct navigation to logout endpoint while unauthenticated is blocked
preconditions: User is not authenticated (not logged in)
steps: 1. In the browser address bar, navigate directly to the application's logout URL (e.g., /logout) as an unauthenticated user
test_cases.expected_result: Request is blocked due to precondition 'user must be logged in' and the user is redirected to the login page; the UI displays the login page and no logout success flow (no redirect to home) occurs

test_cases.test_case: Accessing a protected page after logout redirects to login
steps: 1. Click the Logout button while authenticated

test_cases.expected_result: Protected page access is blocked because user is no longer authenticated; the browser is redirected to the login page and the protected page content is not displayed

test_cases.test_case: Rapid double-click of Logout button
steps: 1. Click the Logout button
2. Immediately click the Logout button again (within one second)
3. Observe the resulting page and visible UI elements
test_cases.expected_result: First click succeeds: session is terminated, sensitive session data cleared, and user is redirected to the home page. Second click is ignored (no additional session is created) and no error message is shown; the Logout button is not visible on the home page.

test_cases.test_case: Browser Back button after logout should not reveal protected content
preconditions: A protected page is reachable via Access_Protected_Page
steps: 1. Click Access_Protected_Page to navigate to a protected page
2. Verify protected content is displayed
3. Click the Logout button
4. After redirect to the home page, click the browser Back button once
5. Observe the resulting page and URL
test_cases.expected_result: Navigation back to the protected page is blocked; the browser redirects to the login page (or shows the login screen) and protected content is not visible.

test_cases.test_case: Logout in one tab invalidates session in another tab when accessing protected page
preconditions: User is logged in in two separate browser tabs
steps: 1. In Tab A, ensure Logout button is visible
2. In Tab B, ensure Access_Protected_Page is available
3. In Tab A, click the Logout button
4. In Tab B, click Access_Protected_Page
5. Observe the resulting page and visible UI elements in Tab B
test_cases.expected_result: Access to the protected page from Tab B is blocked after the logout in Tab A; Tab B navigation redirects to the login page and protected content is not displayed.
